The integrity of the downloaded binaries is verified using SHA-256 checksums, which are explicitly listed and match the respective architecture-specific assets.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, unauthorized network requests, or dangerous operations such as `eval`, `curl|bash`, or execution of downloaded scripts. The use of `install` is consistent with standard packaging practices.

All sources are pinned to specific release versions with fixed checksums, ensuring reproducibility and mitigating supply-chain risks. The package conflicts with an older version of itself and provides a virtual package name, both of which are common practices. No evidence of malicious behavior, data exfiltration, or unauthorized system modifications was found.
